title: EmoMed: An Emotionally-Aware Agent for Multimodal Medical Support with Real-Time Information Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.07194v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present EmoMed - a multimodal medical consultation agent that adapts its responses based on users' emotional states while maintaining clinical accuracy. The system processes text and medical images, detects affect indicators (anxiety, confusion, urgency) from user input, and adjusts response tone, structure, and detail level accordingly. To ensure factual reliability, the agent grounds clinical information through a dual retrieval mechanism: web-based fact-checking and an API-connected, continuously updated medical knowledge base. We evaluate our approach across seven state-of-the-art language models (GPT-4/5, Qwen3, Llama 4, Gemini 2.5, Grok4, Claude3) using comprehensive metrics including LLM-as-judge assessments, MedQA style accuracy tests, BERT Score, safety/helpfulness ratings, and multimodal medical benchmarks. The results demonstrate that emotionally adaptive responses consistently outperform neutral baseline across evaluation

translated_title: EmoMed：具有实时信息检索的情感感知型多模态医疗支持智能体
translated_abstract: 我们提出了EmoMed——一个多模态医疗咨询智能体，它能够在保持临床准确性的同时，根据用户的情绪状态调整其回复。该系统可处理文本和医学图像，从用户输入中检测情感指标（焦虑、困惑、紧迫性），并相应地调整回复的语气、结构和详细程度。为确保事实可靠性，该智能体通过双重检索机制来支撑临床信息：基于网络的事实核查和通过API连接的持续更新的医学知识库。我们在七个最先进的语言模型（GPT-4/5、Qwen3、Llama 4、Gemini 2.5、Grok4、Claude3）上评估了该方法，使用了包括LLM-as-judge评估、MedQA风格准确度测试、BERT Score、安全性/有用性评分以及多模态医学基准在内的综合指标。结果表明，情感自适应回复在各项评估中始终优于中性基线。
tldr: EmoMed是一个能够感知用户情绪并动态调整回复风格的情感感知型多模态医疗咨询智能体，它通过“网络事实核查+实时医学知识库”双重检索机制确保临床信息的准确性，实验证明情感自适应回复在多个前沿大模型上均优于中性基线。
en_tdlr: EmoMed is an emotionally-aware multimodal medical consultation agent that adapts its responses to users' emotional states while ensuring clinical accuracy through dual retrieval (web-based fact-checking and a real-time medical knowledge base), with emotionally adaptive responses consistently outperforming neutral baselines.
